user.title: Add an alert
user.description: Watch an entity and repeat a notification for as long as it stays in the alerting state.

data_description.entity_id: The alert fires while this entity sits in the alerting state.
data_description.state: State of the watched entity that makes the alert fire.
data_description.repeat: Minutes between notifications. Add several values to escalate: the last one is then repeated forever.
data_description.skip_first: Wait for the first repeat delay before notifying, instead of notifying as soon as the alert fires.
data_description.can_acknowledge: Adds a switch that mutes the notifications until the alert clears.
data_description.notifiers: Legacy notify services to call, without the notify. prefix.
data_description.notify_entities: Notify entities to send the message to.
data_description.message: Template rendered as the notification message. Defaults to the alert name.
data_description.title: Template rendered as the notification title.
data_description.done_message: Template sent once the alert clears, only if a notification was sent.
data_description.data: Extra payload passed to the legacy notify services. Notify entities ignore it.

error.repeat_required: At least one repeat delay is required.
error.repeat_too_short: Repeat delays must be at least one second (0.017 minutes).
